authoring_item_1_np2_stability_protocol.why_no_scalar_target: The accepted research-question record fixes no event-set size, selects no information-content or calibration metric, and declares no acceptable posterior or coverage distortion. A scalar accuracy target for the normalization therefore has no derivable provenance, and inventing one is forbidden. V4 instead freezes a decision rule whose every comparison scale is computed at execution from formulas frozen here, with no adjustable parameter.

distinguished_concepts.floating_point_reproducibility: same frozen software and inputs produce the same bits on the same runtime; established by provenance, not by refinement
distinguished_concepts.refinement_stability: behaviour of one family's estimate across its own frozen ladder
distinguished_concepts.cross_family_numerical_stability: agreement between two independently implemented families at their finest frozen level
distinguished_concepts.implementation_comparison: whether two implementations of the same rule family agree
distinguished_concepts.physics_correctness: not addressed by any of the above
distinguished_concepts.physical_or_theory_uncertainty: a different object entirely and not claimed
distinguished_concepts.normalized_law_stability: behaviour of q = r / Z under the frozen protocol

frozen_before_execution.statistic: Z(theta, family, level), the normalization integral estimate on the frozen conditional HERA domain in the frozen t=ln(x), u=ln(Q2) coordinates
frozen_before_execution.comparison_direction: coarse to fine within a family; family A against family B at the finest level only

arithmetic_noise_formulas.family_a_accumulation: numpy.dot pairwise summation; eps_A = gamma_k * S_A with k = ceil(log2(n)) and gamma_k = k*u/(1-k*u), S_A = sum of abs(w_i * f_i) over the evaluated nodes
arithmetic_noise_formulas.family_b_accumulation: math.fsum is exactly rounded; eps_B = u * abs(Z_B)
arithmetic_noise_formulas.note: Both formulas are properties of the frozen accumulation methods, not chosen tolerances. Their numeric values are computed at execution from quantities the run itself produces.

frozen_before_execution.within_family_criterion: d1 = abs(Z_L2 - Z_L1); d2 = abs(Z_L3 - Z_L2); require d2 <= d1 for each family at each theta anchor
frozen_before_execution.cross_family_criterion: abs(Z_A_finest - Z_B_finest) <= d2_A + d2_B + eps_A + eps_B, evaluated at each theta anchor
frozen_before_execution.near_zero_behavior: All criteria are absolute differences. No relative division is performed anywhere in this rule, so no near-zero division can arise.
frozen_before_execution.absolute_versus_relative_switching_rule: None is required, because the rule is purely absolute; a relative form is explicitly not used and may not be substituted later.
frozen_before_execution.anchor_aggregation: Per anchor. Every one of the nine theta anchors must satisfy every criterion independently. There is no averaging, no best-of, no median, and no anchor may be dropped.

acceptance_semantics.PASS: At every theta anchor: all six estimates finite; Z_A_finest > 0 and Z_B_finest > 0; the within-family criterion holds for both families; and the cross-family criterion holds.
acceptance_semantics.FAIL: Any nonfinite estimate; any nonpositive finest-level estimate; or the cross-family criterion violated at any anchor.
acceptance_semantics.INCONCLUSIVE: The within-family criterion violated at any anchor with everything else satisfied, that is non-monotone or growing successive differences. INCONCLUSIVE is never PASS.

frozen_before_execution.failure_precedence: NONFINITE_ESTIMATE, then NORMALIZATION_NONPOSITIVE, then CROSS_FAMILY_DISAGREEMENT, then REFINEMENT_NONMONOTONE
frozen_before_execution.work_limit: the frozen integrand-evaluation counts in the resource model; exceeding them is RESOURCE_EXHAUSTION and is INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS
frozen_before_execution.no_retry_rule: No retry, no re-run with modified settings, no point deletion, no post-hoc tuning, no adaptive insertion.

outcome.derivation: All seven authoring items are frozen and internally consistent. The NP2 stability protocol is fully predeclared with no invented scalar, because every comparison scale is computed at execution from formulas frozen here. The grid gate is replaced by an exact structural audit whose nesting claims were verified in this task, including the explicit finding that the Gauss-Legendre levels are not nested. The massless reference is frozen with its unbound items declared, and the candidate-side grid is bound by reference to APFEL's source-defined defaults rather than invented. The bridge is extended to a second boundary profile with a recounted work cap. The alpha diagnostic is serialized and explicitly non-gating. Runtime identity is classified per dependency with source hashes explicitly not treated as executable verification. Resources are recounted from first principles with units defined and only one additive aggregate. The component coverage matrix is complete over all sixteen components with no undisclosed load-bearing validation gap.
